ROK_2015_p57__paragraph_0.ocr:
At September 30, 2015, the authorized stock of the Company consisted of one billion shares of common stock, par value $1.00 per share, and 
25 million shares of preferred stock, without par value. At September 30, 2015, 9.0 million shares of authorized common stock were reserved for 
various incentive plans.

ROK_2015_p57__paragraph_1.ocr:
At September 30, 2015 and 2014 there were $12.5 million and $4.5 million, respectively, of outstanding common stock share repurchases recorded in 
accounts payable that did not settle until the next fiscal year. While not material to previously issued financial statements, we corrected certain amounts in the rollforward of additional paid-in capital within our 
Consolidated Statement of Shareowners’ Equity for the year ended September 30, 2014. Within the rollforward of additional paid-in capital, income tax 
benefits from share-based compensation decreased by $11.8 million, and share-based compensation expense increased by $11.8 million.
